nested_resolutions.coarse: chromatic anthocyanin pigmentation present versus absent, or source-equivalent binary biochemical presence state
nested_resolutions.intermediate: source-defined major anthocyanin/anthocyanidin biochemical class using a semantics-only mapping frozen before values are inspected
nested_resolutions.fine: source-defined visible hue/reflectance class; if continuous-only, external colour-space cutpoints must be frozen before target values are inspected

schema_stop_rule: HOLD_SCHEMA if three nested levels cannot be instantiated without outcome-dependent recoding

primary_statistic.permutation_unit: jointly permute the complete coarse/intermediate/fine state triplet across eligible tips

decision_rule.PROFILE_SIGNALLED_COARSE: coarse AUC>0.5 with p<=0.05 and coarse exceeds both alternatives with winner-vs-runner-up joint-permutation p<=0.05
decision_rule.PROFILE_SIGNALLED_INTERMEDIATE: intermediate satisfies the corresponding unique-winner rule
decision_rule.PROFILE_SIGNALLED_FINE: fine satisfies the corresponding unique-winner rule
decision_rule.PROFILE_SIGNALLED_TIED: at least one resolution has AUC>0.5 with p<=0.05 but no unique winner clears p<=0.05
decision_rule.PROFILE_NO_PHYLOGENETIC_SIGNAL: no resolution has AUC>0.5 with p<=0.05

cross_radiation_hypothesis: identity of the resolution carrying the strongest phylogenetic signal is not invariant across angiosperm radiations

moderator_policy.reason: biological replication count too small and discovery systems are not all measured with the exact same AUC estimand

forbidden_pre_freeze_exposure: threshold tuning using realized Gesnerioideae outcomes
